t: This is the Shaw Library, also called the Founder's Room, on the sixth floor of the Old Building at the London School of Economics. It's a general-purpose library and common room, open to all members of the university. It was founded by Charlotte Payne-Townshend Shaw, an Irish political activist and Fabian Society member, dedicated to women's rights. She was the wife of the playwright George Bernard Shaw, and the library carries her married name.
